name: mobdeals-meta-automation-suite
description: Standalone Facebook Page automation service for MobDeals Kenya.

scripts.build: npm run build:dashboard && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=wrangler.log wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist --env=""
scripts.dev: npm run build:dashboard && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=wrangler.log wrangler dev
scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test --workspace dashboard
